write_json: write a Python object to a JSON file with pretty printing and auto-created directories
read_json: read a JSON file and return its contents or a default value if the file is missing
write_data_json: serialize a dataclass_json object to a JSON file using the class schema
read_data_json: deserialize a JSON file into a dataclass_json object using the class schema
refactor_write_json: refactor write_json to support custom indentation levels and key sorting options
